data.long_description:
Discover a rare opportunity to lease a spacious Shell & Core office unit perfectly positioned in the heart of Dubai Investment Park First. Located at the rear of the building, this unit overlooks a serene central courtyard and open landscape, offering a quiet and inspiring workspace environment.

With large floor-to-ceiling windows, the space is bathed in natural light, creating an airy and productive atmosphere ideal for a growing business. The unit features dual access doors and comes with five dedicated parking spaces, making it convenient for both staff and clients.

Unit Highlights:

Shell & Core condition – customizable to your business needs
Rear-facing with views of the central courtyard and open land
Abundant natural light through large windows
2-door access for flexible layout and entry/exit points
5 reserved parking spaces

Building Amenities:
24/7 security and building access
Centralized reception and lobby area
High-speed passenger elevators plus dedicated service elevators
Ample visitor parking and underground parking facilities
Well-maintained common area restrooms
On-site cafes and F&B options within the building

This unit is ideal for a serious occupier ready to establish a bespoke office setup in a strategic, accessible location.
